digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI workflows
propositions: External integration suite currently tests only one live provider (Anthropic) despite supporting Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI-compatible providers, leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetectable by CI automation.
Provider selection must become an explicit matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, so each credentialed provider runs as a separate test arm.

Provider selection must use REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to config files setting [llm.model_classes], not the deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL, to ensure deep-merge behavior and CI dogfooding of the documented local-dev override path.

Bedrock authentication in CI must use OIDC role assumption to a dedicated scoped role via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials (not EC2 instance role or static long-lived secrets), because GitHub-hosted runners lack instance role access.
Bedrock arm must explicitly set both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION as job environment variables and fail loudly on region resolution failure, avoiding silent skips or false passes.

Missing credentials must skip loudly and be visibly distinguished from passing runs in CI output, and cost implications of multi-provider matrix execution must be measured and documented with cadence rationale.
